answer: A mechanism that actually bites: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because pearl only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, vine is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any voyage approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
